lints.name: security_definer_view
lints.title: Security Definer View
lints.description: Detects views defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property. These views enforce Postgres permissions and row level security policies (RLS) of the view creator, rather than that of the querying user

findings.detail: View \`public.blog_post_comment_counts\` is defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property
View \`public.blog_post_like_counts\` is defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property
View \`public.seller_rating_stats\` is defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property

lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.is_newsletter_editor()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/is_newsletter_editor`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.is_user_suspended(target_user uuid)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/is_user_suspended`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.validate_blog_comment_parent()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/validate_blog_comment_parent`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.is_newsletter_editor()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/is_newsletter_editor`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.is_user_suspended(target_user uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/is_user_suspended`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.validate_blog_comment_parent()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/validate_blog_comment_parent`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
lints.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
lints.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

lints.name: unindexed_foreign_keys
lints.title: Unindexed foreign keys
lints.description: Identifies foreign key constraints without a covering index, which can impact database performance.

findings.detail: Table \`public.blog_comments\` has a foreign key \`blog_comments_user_id_fkey\` without a covering index. This can lead to suboptimal query performance.
Table \`public.blog_post_likes\` has a foreign key \`blog_post_likes_user_id_fkey\` without a covering index. This can lead to suboptimal query performance.
Table \`public.conversation_hidden\` has a foreign key \`conversation_hidden_user_id_fkey\` without a covering index. This can lead to suboptimal query performance.
Table \`public.newsletter_editors\` has a foreign key \`newsletter_editors_added_by_fkey\` without a covering index. This can lead to suboptimal query performance.
Table \`public.user_flags\` has a foreign key \`user_flags_suspended_by_fkey\` without a covering index. This can lead to suboptimal query performance.

lints.name: auth_rls_initplan
lints.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
lints.description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row

findings.detail: Table \`public.blog_post_likes\` has a row level security policy \`blog_likes_own_read\` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing \`auth.<function>()\` with \`(select auth.<function>())\`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.
